title: Vocabulary Bingo
description: Review familiar English words through a bingo game.
instructions: Prepare bingo cards with target vocabulary.
Give each student one card.
Call out words in random order.
Students mark matching words.
Check the first completed row and celebrate the winner.

title: Picture Description
description: Describe people, objects, and actions in pictures.
instructions: Show a clear picture to the class.
Model a simple descriptive sentence.
Ask students to name objects, colors, and actions.
Have pairs describe different parts of the picture.
Invite volunteers to share their sentences.

title: Word Association
description: Build connections between everyday English words.
instructions: Write a familiar word in the center of the board.
Ask students for related English words.
Record answers around the original word.
Discuss how the words are connected.
Review new vocabulary aloud.

title: Grammar Challenge
description: Review grammar structures in a team competition.
instructions: Divide the class into small teams.
Display or read one grammar question at a time.
Allow teams time to agree on an answer.
Award a point for each correct response.
Explain the rules behind the answers.

title: Find Someone Who
description: Practice question forms while interviewing classmates.
instructions: Give students a worksheet of prompts.
Model one question and answer.
Students circulate and ask classmates questions.
They record the names of matching classmates.
Discuss interesting findings as a class.

title: Sentence Scramble
description: Practice English word order by rebuilding sentences.
instructions: Prepare sets of words from complete sentences.
Give each pair one scrambled set.
Ask pairs to arrange the words correctly.
Have pairs read their sentences aloud.
Check the order and explain any mistakes.

title: Story Sequencing
description: Order key events from a short story.
instructions: Choose a short age-appropriate story.
Have students read it once for understanding.
Give groups shuffled event cards.
Ask groups to place events in order.
Review the sequence using evidence from the text.

title: Listening Detective
description: Identify important details in a short audio recording.
instructions: Introduce the topic and key vocabulary.
Play the audio once for the main idea.
Give students detail questions.
Play the audio again.
Compare answers and discuss supporting clues.

title: Role-Play Situations
description: Practice useful conversational language in realistic situations.
instructions: Prepare everyday situations such as shopping or ordering food.
Assign a role to each partner.
Provide time to plan expressions.
Pairs perform short dialogues.
Give feedback on clarity and useful language.

title: Reading Detectives
description: Find textual evidence to support reading answers.
instructions: Distribute a suitable reading passage.
Ask students to identify its main idea.
Give factual and inference questions.
Have students underline evidence for each answer.
Discuss why the evidence supports the answer.

title: Creative Story Writing
description: Write an original short story from a prompt.
instructions: Present a prompt featuring a character or problem.
Ask students to brainstorm ideas.
Have them draft a beginning, middle, and ending.
Allow time for peer feedback and revision.
Invite volunteers to share their stories.

title: Classroom Debate
description: Defend opinions using reasons and examples.
instructions: Choose an appropriate debatable topic.
Assign students to opposing teams.
Give preparation time for arguments and evidence.
Run timed opening statements and responses.
Debrief respectful disagreement and useful expressions.

title: Flashcard Match
description: Match images with the correct English words.
instructions: Prepare matching picture and word cards.
Mix the cards and distribute them to groups.
Ask groups to match each picture to its word.
Have students pronounce each match.
Review any difficult words together.

title: Odd One Out
description: Identify the word that does not belong in a category.
instructions: Show sets of four familiar words.
Ask students to select the odd word out.
Invite them to explain the category shared by the other words.
Compare different reasonable explanations.
Create one new set as a class.

title: Action Commands
description: Follow spoken classroom commands in English.
instructions: Teach a few simple commands such as stand up or point to the door.
Model each action while speaking.
Give commands without demonstrating.
Increase the sequence to two or three actions.
Let students take turns giving commands.

title: Sound and Picture Match
description: Connect spoken words to corresponding pictures.
instructions: Provide a sheet of numbered pictures.
Say a target word clearly twice.
Ask students to point to or circle the correct picture.
Repeat with the remaining words.
Check answers and practice pronunciation.

title: My Daily Routine
description: Write simple sentences about everyday routines.
instructions: Review common routine verbs.
Write one model sentence on the board.
Ask students to draft five sentences about their day.
Have partners check spelling and verb forms.
Invite students to read one sentence aloud.

title: Mini Dialogue Cards
description: Practice short conversations using familiar expressions.
instructions: Review greetings and basic question forms.
Give pairs a simple dialogue prompt.
Allow students to rehearse with a partner.
Ask pairs to perform the exchange.
Switch partners and repeat with a new prompt.

title: Verb Tense Sort
description: Sort example sentences by their verb tense.
instructions: Review the target tenses with examples.
Give groups mixed sentence cards.
Ask them to sort the cards under tense labels.
Have groups explain the clues they used.
Correct misunderstandings together.

title: Information Gap
description: Exchange information to complete a missing-data worksheet.
instructions: Prepare partner sheets with different missing information.
Pair students and explain they must not show sheets.
Model questions for requesting missing details.
Students ask and answer to complete their sheets.
Check the finished information together.

title: Postcard Writing
description: Write a short postcard using place and activity vocabulary.
instructions: Show an example postcard.
Review greetings and useful place words.
Ask students to choose a travel destination.
Have them write a short message about their visit.
Exchange postcards for peer reading.

title: True or False Reading
description: Check comprehension by judging statements about a text.
instructions: Give students a short text to read.
Present statements related to its content.
Ask students to mark each statement true or false.
Have students highlight evidence in the text.
Correct false statements together.

title: Question Word Relay
description: Practice choosing the correct wh-question word.
instructions: Review who, what, where, when, why, and how.
Divide learners into teams.
Display a sentence missing a question word.
Ask one representative per team to supply a suitable word.
Discuss why each answer fits.

title: Story Listening Map
description: Record characters, places, and events while listening.
instructions: Introduce the story and its setting.
Play or read the story once.
Students fill in a map of characters, places, and events.
Replay key parts as needed.
Compare maps with a partner and review.

title: Opinion Corners
description: Express and justify opinions through classroom discussion.
instructions: Label corners from strongly agree to strongly disagree.
Read a discussion statement aloud.
Ask students to choose a position.
Invite them to explain their reasons in English.
Allow students to change positions after discussion.

title: Email Writing Workshop
description: Write a clear email for a real-life purpose.
instructions: Analyze the parts of a short example email.
Choose a realistic message purpose.
Ask students to draft a subject, greeting, body, and closing.
Have partners review clarity and tone.
Revise the email using feedback.

title: Context Clue Hunt
description: Infer the meanings of unfamiliar words from context.
instructions: Select a text with a few unfamiliar words.
Ask learners to read the surrounding sentences.
Have them predict meanings using context clues.
Compare predictions in small groups.
Confirm meanings and discuss the clues.

title: Podcast Key Points
description: Identify main ideas and supporting details from audio.
instructions: Introduce the episode topic.
Play the excerpt once for general understanding.
Ask students to note three key points.
Play it again to verify details.
Have groups summarize the message.

title: Error Correction Lab
description: Spot and correct common English sentence errors.
instructions: Provide sentences with one targeted error each.
Ask learners to identify the error individually.
Have pairs propose corrected versions.
Invite explanations of the grammar rules.
Reveal and discuss the corrections.

title: Vocabulary Categories Race
description: Expand topic vocabulary through quick category challenges.
instructions: Choose themes such as travel, food, or technology.
Divide students into small teams.
Give teams a short time to write matching words.
Compare unique and accurate words.
Review meanings and pronunciation.

title: Persuasive Paragraph
description: Develop a convincing argument in one organized paragraph.
instructions: Present a question with more than one defensible position.
Model a topic sentence and supporting reasons.
Ask students to plan an argument with examples.
Have them write and revise a paragraph.
Use a checklist to assess organization and evidence.

title: Article Analysis
description: Analyze an article’s argument, evidence, and tone.
instructions: Choose a short opinion article.
Ask students to identify the author’s main claim.
Highlight supporting evidence and language choices.
Discuss the intended audience and tone.
Write a brief critical response.

title: News Summary Challenge
description: Summarize an audio news report accurately.
instructions: Preview key topic vocabulary.
Play the report and ask students to note the main issue.
Play again for key facts and perspectives.
Students prepare a concise spoken or written summary.
Compare summaries for accuracy and neutrality.

title: Conditional Scenarios
description: Use conditionals to discuss hypothetical outcomes.
instructions: Review the conditional structures being practiced.
Give groups cards describing hypothetical situations.
Ask students to write conditional responses.
Have groups compare possible outcomes.
Review verb forms and meaning.

title: Academic Word Families
description: Explore word forms and usage in academic English.
instructions: Introduce a set of academic root words.
Ask learners to identify related nouns, verbs, and adjectives.
Use a dictionary to check spelling and meaning.
Have students write contextual sentences with different forms.
Discuss common collocations.

title: Problem-Solving Meeting
description: Collaborate to propose and defend solutions to a problem.
instructions: Introduce a realistic community or school problem.
Assign meeting roles to small groups.
Give time to prepare possible solutions.
Hold a structured discussion to agree on a plan.
Ask each group to present its decision and reasoning.
